proposed_exploratory_families.rationale: trend carry may be offset by tail loss; close-based ATR controls exposure without claiming stop fill
proposed_exploratory_families.rules: use pre-existing trend fast12/slow48 on completed 4h bars; ATR14 using only prior completed bars; 2x ATR protective exit signal and no same-bar idealized fills; first observed authentic executable quote after permitted delay
proposed_exploratory_families.mandatory_caveat: stop gaps and unfilled orders require actual quotes; cannot claim drawdown protection from close marks

proposed_exploratory_families.rationale: momentum may perform differently in volatility regimes
proposed_exploratory_families.rules: use pre-existing fixed momentum lookback12 entry>2%, exit<=0; admit entries only if trailing14-bar ATR/close is <= trailing90-bar median of that ratio computed strictly at signal time; no other parameters selected using held-out returns

proposed_exploratory_families.rationale: mean reversion may be overwhelmed in high-volatility trends
proposed_exploratory_families.rules: use existing window24 and entry_z=-1.5/exit_z=0; entry allowed only when realized volatility of 24 completed close returns <= trailing90-observation median of the same statistic at signal time

proposed_exploratory_families.rationale: select positive cross-asset relative strength without overlap or simultaneous separate accounts
proposed_exploratory_families.rules: at most one $25 leg in a single $100 USDC account; compare WETH and cbBTC trailing12 four-hour close returns, choose highest strictly positive and above cash, rebalance only on a changed winner, min order and risk caps unchanged; both asset candles must be complete

proposed_exploratory_families.rationale: independently attributable wallet flow may have conditional predictive value, not proved by explorer balances
proposed_exploratory_families.rules: no autonomous wallet-copy execution; veto or confirm an otherwise eligible frozen S0 signal only when timestamped signer, actual acquisition lots, fresh quote and follower-time direction are independently corroborated; if unavailable remain abstain/blocked
